description: Use when the user wants an overview of a whole market/category — every player in it, not just a self-selected competitor set. Given a market (a vertical slug or name), returns the published category overview plus every player IndustryLens tracks in that market — the whole-CATEGORY map, not a self-selected competitor set. Returns the hub (title, abstract, tldr, hero_stats, content_refreshed_at, url), the deduped list of players (name, domain, business_model), and `market_news` — the latest weekly market summary (narrative, top topics, new entrants, topic momentum, source URLs). On an authenticated account, passing your OWN market (see list_markets) returns your account's market view (your tracked players, `source: "account"`) instead of { covered: false }, even when that market is outside the public showcase set. Returns { covered: false } for markets IndustryLens doesn't publicly track and that aren't your own. Use list_markets to discover slugs.

market.description: A vertical slug (exact) or market name (ILIKE), e.g. 'sales-intelligence' or 'sales intelligence'.

name: get_market_landscape
title: Get the whole-category map for a market
